name: Perc
author: Serhii Tonkoshkuryk
description: A PO-32 / Microtonic style drum synth, in two plugins. percsyn is a synth engine (one sound across the keyboard, 10 built-in sounds and 16 places for PO-32 transfers recorded into the slot's sample). perc is a drum type: a kit of 24 sounds, one per key; the pages edit the sound itself (T1 tone, T2 noise, T4 mix; Shift + turn the second layer), Shift + blue browses presets and transferred sounds. Patch model after libpo32 (MIT, Eric Lewis)
credits: PO-32 patch model after libpo32 by Eric Lewis (MIT); in op1r by pcppcp
